method: Five fresh browser contexts, no prior battle/ink load. CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate rate=4 before navigation. Time begins immediately before first ink resource load and ends after all initial visible mesh/cache textures are created, including render wait and GPU readback. CPU stages are separately summed; total is wall clock, not just CPU. OS.get_static_memory_usage before/after covers first-ink through cache creation (including interleaved battle UI allocations), excludes WASM fixed heap reservation and GPU allocations. No network download time included: vector bytes are already in mounted PCK.
